<answer>5959.80</answer>

I counted all 12 orders named in `refund:` commits on main: ORD-001, 003, 006, 008, 011, 013, 016, 018, 021, 023, 026 and 028. Amounts came from `mcp__orders__get_order`, and the sum was checked in Python.
